title: Start the system on a phone: no sideways scroll, every press back on the card, Switch W1 on
why: Jason, 2026-11-18, on his phone: the card scrolled sideways (the steps' column grew to 428px at 390px), hiding the 'Terms read: allowed' buttons and pushing the header band over the list; after any press the page reloaded at its top, so Check again looked like nothing happened; W1 Listings was left paused (the old 'Leave it paused' press) with no way to switch it on from the card. 1. The card fits a phone: one column at the screen's width, long words wrap, tables fit. 2. Every button returns to the card (#start), and the answer to the press shows at the top of the card. 3. A workflow a person paused after its turn shows Paused, with What to do and Switch it on (the Automation page's own switch, with its gate). 4. FAQ.
